text:
katie-cs: OrchardEdge is seeing p99 spikes on /v1/generate since ~08:15 UTC, customers reporting slow UI. p95 also elevated. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/graphs/2323456789 (logins redacted)

jess-support: thanks — can you share tenant id and any recent config changes? any change to model or traffic pattern?

katie-cs: tenant_id=orchard-edge-prod, no config changes on their side. They said a nightly bulk-embed job started around 07:50.

arun-oncall: looking at infra. Querying queue latency and per-tenant concurrency now.

arun-oncall: result snippets — queue_latency_ms{tenant="orchard-edge-prod"} p95=210ms p99=2.8s, api_resp_time_ms p99=3.1s. Total reqs spiked from 80/s -> 420/s at 07:50.

arun-oncall: logs show many long-lived embed requests from a single IP range for orchard-edge, likely noisy neighbor causing KV-cache pressure.

jess-support: sounds like noisy neighbor. Short term we can route orchard-edge to priority lane (soft-reservation) or throttle their concurrent requests. What's fastest?

darien (deploy-bot): Reservation API available — create ephemeral reservation or add tenant to priority-lane allowlist.

darien (deploy-bot): Usage: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/reservations -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"orchard-edge-prod","duration_minutes":60,"concurrency":60}'

darien (deploy-bot): Created ephemeral reservation id=ephem-2323 (simulated).

arun-oncall: I can flip a soft throttle: set per-tenant concurrency cap to 50 and drop large-batch embeds to background queue. Doing config change now (should be <2m).

arun-oncall: applied: tenant_concurrency_limit{orchard-edge-prod}=50, background_priority=false. Also added tenant to priority-lane allowlist for next-60m so control plane routes their low-latency calls to dedicated pool.

jess-support: thank you. Can you paste the command you used so I can capture for the runbook?

arun-oncall: commands: 
```
# soft throttle
kubectl exec -it control-plane-0 -- /bin/sh -c "redctl tenant update --id orchard-edge-prod --concurrency 50"
# create ephemeral reservation (admin api)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/reservations -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"orchard-edge-prod","duration_minutes":60,"concurrency":60}'
```

darien (deploy-bot): ticket created: INF-4271 — "orchard-edge p99 tail spike, ephemeral reservation + throttle applied". Assigned to eng-infra.

jess-support: please confirm expected p99 improvement and when we should tell the customer.

arun-oncall: after changes p99 dropped to ~420ms within 90s, p95 back to ~130ms — monitoring.

katie-cs: relaying to customer now — I'll tell them we applied short-term reservation and throttle, eng is investigating root cause for a permanent fix.

darien (deploy-bot): note: recommend follow-ups — (1) schedule tenant burst-reservation option for OrchardEdge, (2) implement server-side batch-size caps per-tenant, (3) add quota alert on sustained embed-batch rates.

jess-support: added runbook entry and flagged for postmortem if it recurs. Closing this thread once INF-4271 has a timeline. :white_check_mark:
